reviews.review: Story is there, but I couldnt really care less. Great combat, great visuals and a great game feel. TIENOUTTATIEN

This game is seriously the most fun you can have with your pants on!

If you want THE quintessential Warhammer 40K experience, this is it. It is brutal, alredanline pumping, blood soaked fun! The game follows a Command Squad of three of the Ultramarines (you play as 2nd Company Commander Titus), called in as reinforcements to the war torn Forge world of Graia. You are big, you are hulking and nothing stands in your way. You ARE a Space Marine and this game gets MASSIVE praise for making me feel like one!

In terms of Gameplay, Space Marine plays a lot like the love child of 'Gears of War' and 'God of War' in relation to its shooting and melee mechanics. The controls are slick, the game looks fantastic and it was very fun to just pick up and play. This coupled with a FANTASTIC story ripped straight out of the 40K universe makes it a must have title.

25 out of 10. Would absolutely reccommend!

Warhammer Space Marine is an amazingly fun game to play, chopping with chainswords, shooting your bolter and swooping in with a jumppack. The campain is lots of fun, especially if your a Warhammer fan... Space Marines, Orks and Chaos :) 

I have the game on PS3 and have approximatly 500 hours in game playing time. I dont play it on PS3 anymore, because of TV --> Wife...... you get the picture.

Multiplayer has lots of game types, however due to the dwindling playerbase only a few options have a large enough playerbase to be viable.

The game was originally made for console and some controls and the UI are a bit clunky. Running is shift as in most first and third person shooters/hack and slashers, but it is not hold to run, it is press once to run (like on a controller (L/R top buttons.) 

The game does suffer from THQ / Relic Entertainment licenses for the Warhammer series going to SEGA. Updates are rare to non existend, sometimes it lags terribly for no apparent reason (no it's not your internet, WiFi or PC... probably) and the playerbase is getting less.

However the player that still play are hardcore and luckily helpfull. 

I would like to give it the 8/10 it deserves, but due to the "problems" it gets a 6/10.
However if you can get it on sale, I would still recommend it.

Now this is one of few 40k games that have the best: settings, story, gameplay and graphics. From the first to the last mission in campagin you will be butcher of Forge World Graia, the number of Orks that you will kill is beyond any reasonably number and it's feels so good. When you get really angry or you feel overrun , just use "Fury" mode and you're done with them. Now here you will feel too much overpowerd but again it feels so good. The game is fully in 3rd person view mod, you can only get in 1st person view mod if you aim with the scope. I must say that I like settings and visual graphics of the game. Everywhere you look you will get that feel of 40k battlefield, completely destroyed city full with bodies of fallen Imperial Guardmans, sad like every other 40k story. When you finished with killing Orks and Chaos legions in campaign you can launch CO-OP which has only one mod, a wave mod. Here you need to defend against 20 waves of Orks and Chaos. Today with lacking players for PvP multiplayer you will spend more time playing only CO-OP mode. When comes to Multiplayer and PvP gameplay, you will get problems. Problem number one, lack of players. Peek number of player daily is ~300 players. Problem number two, playing this game in 3rd person MP is not really interesing to play, you will die often and even when you kill other player, you will get that "meh" effect. It's just that MP game mode looks so simple and boring, very boring. Don't buy this game for MP !

Pros:
- Great visuals
- Great 40k settings
- Good story
- Good gameplay
- Plenty of Orks to kill
- CO-OP mode
- Space Marines are Overpowerd

Cons:
- Multiplayer 
- Lack of people playing it
- Multiplayer gameplay
- Killing Orks gets little boring

I highly recommend this game mainly and only for Campaign game play. CO-OP is also fun but it lacks maps. But If you want to play Multiplayer against other players, then you will be disappointed, people just don't play this game. As a 40k fan this is a must have game. Oh and don't buy it for a full price, try to buy it on the sale or something like that.

We March for Macragge !!!

When i first played the demo i was amazed. The combat system is fast, full of adrenaline, and the melee and ranged combat is just perfect together. It feels absolutely good to blow a head of an orc off or slice him in two. The weakest point in the game is the single player with an average story and weak boss fights, but the multiplayer is the best out there. Its quite balanced, very fast paced, and very unique. The exterminatus game mode offers you the joy of slaughtering hordes of enemies, and a hard challenge at the same time. Buy the game, get out there with a heavy bolter, shoot some orcs, and u will know what I was talkin about.
